inputs.prompt: These pictures show one person from several views. Describe their appearance so a video model can redraw them exactly: face, hair, facial hair, eyewear, jewelry and other accessories, and the clothing from top to bottom including shoes. Name colors and materials. Study any close-up of the face for small details such as a monocle (a single lens over one eye, often on a chain), earrings or piercings, and state them precisely. Describe only how they look, never their pose, gestures, expression or what they're doing: the video decides those. Don't say left or right. One paragraph under 90 words, no preamble.
